subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility config for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only privacy-sensitive sections such as usage/cost?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent output shape and new config surface affect privacy, agent UX, docs, and compatibility, so automation should not choose the public contract.

options.title: Add documented visibility control
options.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that keeps current output for existing users while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

options.title: Limit to privacy sections
options.body: Add a narrower usage/cost suppression setting if maintainers want to solve the sensitive-data concern without creating a broad status-card mode.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible and close the request as not planned if maintainers decide the extra configuration is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Add documented visibility control
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that keeps current output for existing users while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original `session_status` surface and already framed this issue as the canonical tracker in prior discussion.
